messages:
Maria Lopez: Quick async standup — prepping for the east-coast customer stress test tomorrow morning. Need current AZ headroom and any quota risks. I've scheduled prewarm + spot fallback for us-east1. Details below.

Drew Chen: What I did: increased prewarm pool in us-east1 by 20 A100s, adjusted autoscaler min->40. Ran a dry terraform apply:
```
terraform apply -target=module.prewarm_us_east1
```
Blockers: cloud provider reporting intermittent spot reclaim noise in us-east1c.
Today: will validate canary and flip traffic if 30m looks stable.

Lucas Patel: Quotas: project-prod GPU quota in us-east1 = 120, current used = 96, reserved for Dedicated = 30 -> effective free = -6 (we're short). I can submit quota raise but need justification + expected sustained usage window.

Tess Nguyen: What I did: finished onprem packaging tests for private deploy in us-west1. Blocker: KMS key for customer X stuck in approval. Without that private test can't run. @Maria can you escalate with security? :slightly_frowning_face:

Sam Rivera: Quick ops note + ping: PR #428 reduces KV cache TTL to speed cold-starts. Needs 1 reviewer. @Drew can you take a look? Small perf risk but should drop tail latency on short requests.

infra-bot: [alert] capacity-snapshot: us-east1 free-GPUs dropped below 10 at 2023-11-03T08:12:02Z. Autoscaler triggered 2 prewarm instances.

Drew Chen: Acked @Sam, will review PR in ~15m. Also @Lucas — can you file a quota raise and include the customer test window (tomorrow 09-11 UTC) so we can get temporary bump? I'll hold 10 GPUs in warm pool until approval.

Maria Lopez: Thanks all. Action items: @Lucas file quota raise w/window; @Tess I'll loop in security for KMS; @Drew run canary and post 09:00 UTC status; @Sam will add a short rollback note to PR. If anything critical pops up, call me. :thumbsup:
